signal: Nitro (an Alludo company) partnered with Canva in May 2025 and extended its Climb Channel distribution into Ireland in December 2025, expanding its global reach.

email.body1:
Joey, saw Nitro's Canva partnership and the Climb distribution push into Ireland, expanding the global footprint.

More regions mean more in-market accounts and more follow-up than a global SDR team can cover by hand, and that's where good leads go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your reps book meetings instead of chasing: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Joey, quick follow-up for Nitro.

Running sales development across regions usually means inconsistent messaging and uneven response rates, and ramp time quietly eats your enablement bandwidth. A tight, consistent motion is the fastest lift you can give a global team right now.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Joey, last bit of proof for Nitro.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

Want to grab time so I can walk you through how Nitro's reply rate compares to other global software teams? I pulled a quick benchmark.
email.body4:
Joey, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If taking follow-up volume off your reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running enablement across regions is a full plate on its own.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a global SDR team? I'll tailor it to Nitro either way.
